dossiers.kill_risk: The load-bearing claim is a ~70% clean win on the strict TND+ALT composite. Refutation from the live record: SOLSTICE's 56% composite used a looser definition (undetectable OR >=2-log drop, plus ALT normalisation); the strict ECLIPSE 1 composite (TND plus ALT normalisation) is plausibly ~40-50%, and ALT normalisation is the noisy component (only 56% normalised ALT at week 48 in SOLSTICE; HBsAg-lowering agents produce ALT excursions). A print near 40% would still beat an untreated arm at p<0.05 but would read as optical parity with bulevirtide's MYR301 composite (45-48%), handing the market the 'stat win, commercial miss' middle outcome in which the stock drifts toward the lose leg despite a technically positive trial. Timing residual: the registry primary-completion date (31 Dec 2026, unchanged since 8 Apr 2026) is the last day of the guided quarter and the company's own Nov 2025 guidance said Q1 2027, so a slip to Jan-Feb 2027 is documented and live. Minor: five Form 144s (21 Aug-17 Sep 2026) show insiders selling into the run.

dossiers.kill_risk: The load-bearing claim is that the ESR1-wild-type cohort is a genuine ~45% coin-flip rather than a likely miss. The refutation from the record: no oral SERD has ever shown a PFS benefit in ESR1wt (EMERALD wt no benefit; EMBER-3 ITT HR 0.87 n.s.; persevERA and SERENA-4 both missed in unselected 1L). Palazestrant's wt evidence is a single-arm Phase 2 mPFS of 5.5 months - which is numerically the same as the EMBER-3 standard-of-care ITT arm (5.5 months). The defence is that OPERA-01 requires prior CDK4/6i, where fulvestrant/AI controls run ~2-3.5 months (EMERALD control 1.9 months), so 5.5 would clear; but that comparison is cross-trial and single-arm. If wt misses, the outcome is the partial branch (~$7, ESR1m-only label competing with Orserdu and Lilly's approved Inluriyo), which the market already discounts. Residual: the full-win $28 leg carries ~30% weight and 70% of outcomes sit at or below the current $8.54. Also live: TD Cowen ATM (~$158m of $200m cap unused) will sell into any pre-readout rally, and the accrued-R&D/secured-loan structure means the cash floor prints below gross cash (see note).

dossiers.kill_risk: FDA declines to accept hemoglobin response as a reasonably-likely surrogate in SCD and issues a CRL asking for REIGNITE data. Filing acceptance with priority review is not approval. Secondary tell: the company has never stated in a primary release that no AdCom is planned; the 29 Oct earnings call sits three days before the goal date and is where a late-cycle issue would surface.
